transcript.content: Hi, welcome in. I'm Dr. Smith. To start, can you tell me what's been bringing you in today?

Hi, Dr. Smith. Well, I guess what finally scared me into actually coming in is... I keep making these really dumb technical mistakes at work. Stuff I definitely know better than to make. 

I work in video production, and lately I'll do things like label camera cards wrong, or, um, miss a timecode note. I've even exported a client cut with the wrong lower-third graphic, even after I swear I just checked it. It's just... it's becoming a real problem and I need to figure out what's going on.
Have you always had a tendency to make careless mistakes or lose focus like this since you were a kid, or is this a new change for you recently?

Well, I guess the careless mistakes part feels a bit worse lately, but... no, honestly, struggling with this kind of thing isn't new. It's been an issue since I was a kid. 

Even back in elementary school, my teachers were always moving my desk. I just couldn't stay in my seat. I was always getting up, blurting out answers before the teacher even finished asking the question, or just bothering the other kids. And the thing is, half the time I didn't even realize I was doing it until I was already getting in trouble for it. So yeah, it's definitely not a recent change.
How has your sleep been lately—are you generally getting enough hours and waking up feeling rested?

My sleep is actually pretty okay. I mean, I usually get about seven or eight hours a night. I don't really have trouble falling asleep or anything, and I usually wake up feeling fine. So, no, I wouldn't say sleep is an issue.
Over the past couple of weeks, have you noticed feeling down, sad, or losing interest in things you usually enjoy?

No, not really. I mean, I definitely get frustrated with myself when I mess up a project or miss something obvious, but I don't feel sad or down in general. And I'm still interested in my usual hobbies and everything. So, no, my mood is mostly fine. It's really just the mistakes that are bothering me.
Can you tell me about your current use of alcohol or any other recreational substances—how much and how often?
I don't really drink or use any drugs. Maybe I'll have a glass of wine at a party or something, but that's pretty rare. So, no, I don't use anything on a regular basis.
